{{Quote|Most people associate the Atrisian Empire with exotic danger&mdash;the brutal conquests of its early rulers, the brilliant but ruthless political gambits of Emperor Uueg Tching, the distilled political craftiness of his ''Sayings'', or the sociopathic decadence of the Six Savage Viziers. While the modern Atrisian Commonwealth is a far more mundane place, Atrisian script, the writing system made ubiquitous planetwide by the Kitel Phard Dynasty, has found a place offworld in hands every bit as pitiless as the ancient emperors.|Doctor Milanda Vorgan, "The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic"|<ref name="Written" />}}
The '''Atrisian Emperor''', also known as the '''Emperor of Atrisia''', was the title of the ruler of the [[Atrisian Empire]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]]-inhabited [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Atrisia/Legends|Atrisia]]. The [[First Atrisian Emperor|first]] holder of the title standardized the [[Atrisian script|writing system]] used in the Atrisian Empire, and the following [[Emperor/Legends|emperors]] carried out [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] conquests. The Atrisian Emperors of the [[Kitel Phard Dynasty]] attempted to unite their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], and the dynasty culminated with the reign of [[Uueg Tching]], the fifty-fourth Atrisian Emperor. Tching expanded the Atrisian Empire's control&mdash;either direct or indirect&mdash;over the entirety of Atrisia, thereby also establishing the use of the [[Atrisian]] [[Writing/Legends|script]] planetwide. Renowned for his successful tyrannical rule, Tching [[Author/Legends|authored]] the ''[[Sayings]]'', a combination of parables, analogies, and instructions concerning [[Politics/Legends|political]] manipulation, grand strategy, internal rule, and conquest. The document was meant to serve as a guide for Tching's successor emperors and marked a significant change in Atrisian politics.

Following Tching's rule, which took place at least three [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] prior to [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], several Atrisian Emperors were part of the [[Tching Dynasty]], including [[Oeana Tching]] and [[Eoaq the Expansive]]. The latter enacted many reforms to the [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]] of the Atrisian Empire, although his simplification of the Atrisian script proved to be among the few lasting ones. Around [[1489 BBY]], the ruling [[Atrisian Emperor (Sayings)|Atrisian Emperor]] had the ''Sayings'' printed in a small run for the Atrisian [[Noble/Legends|nobility]] in order to further his own prestige. The [[Atrisian Parliament]] wrested power from the Atrisian [[Throne/Legends|throne]] by [[539 BBY]]; however, its general-public release of the ''Sayings'' only served to further cement the enduring reputation and legacy of the Atrisian Emperors that outlived the existence of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], with Atrisia itself sometimes being referred to as Kitel Phard after that ancient dynasty.

==Description==
{{Quote|''[The Atrisian script]'' was simplified during Eoaq the Expansive's many reforms to the bureaucracy, and unlike most of those reforms, this simplified script survived the counter-reforms the Six Savage Viziers instituted following his death.|Doctor Milanda Vorgan, "The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic"|<ref name="Written" />}}
The Atrisian Emperor,<ref name="Files" /> also referred to as the Emperor of Atrisia,<ref name="IS2">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> was the title of the ruler of the [[Atrisian Empire]], which was a nation on<ref name="Files" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Atrisia/Legends|Atrisia]], one of the approximately two hundred [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] worlds in the [[Atrisian Commonwealth/Legends|Atrisian Commonwealth]] region. Atrisia was inhabited by a culture of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] known as the [[Atrisian]]s.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The Atrisian Emperor could authorize conquests<ref name="Written" /> and utilize [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] units.<ref name="Rules">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref> They could also enact reforms to the empire's [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]] as well as the standardization and simplification of the [[Atrisian script|writing system]] used in the Atrisian Empire.<ref name="Written" />

==History==
===Unification of a planet===
{{Quote|Atrisian script was standardized by the First Atrisian Emperor, and with the victory of Uueg Tching over the last of the planet's continents, the script was established planetwide.|Doctor Milanda Vorgan, "The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic"|<ref name="Written" />}}
[[File:KitelPhard-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Atrisian Emperors ruled the Atrisian Empire of the planet that eventually came to be referred to as "Kitel Phard" after the Kitel Phard Dynasty.]]
The [[First Atrisian Emperor]] standardized the Atrisian [[Writing/Legends|script]]. The early [[Emperor/Legends|emperors]] of Atrisia were pitiless and carried out brutal conquests. At some point, the [[Kitel Phard Dynasty]] came to rule the Atrisian Empire,<ref name="Written" /> and its rulers set about eliminating opposition<ref name="IS2" /> and also spreading the Atrisian script planetwide.<ref name="Written" /> The emperors of the dynasty employed the special forces unit [[Atrisian Assault Corps]], which was fast, effective, and able to defeat any enemy it encountered. It itself included such units as [[His Majesty's Roto-gunners]] and [[Queen's Own Armored Cavalry Troop]].<ref name="Rules" />

The Human<ref name="TEA" /> [[Uueg Tching]] was the fifty-fourth Atrisian Emperor<ref name="Files" /> and a member of the Kitel Phard Dynasty.<ref name="Insider70">{{InsiderCite|70|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:9:04}}</ref> By the time of his reign, a group of inhabited continents was discovered by the Atrisians, and Tching proceeded to triumph remarkably over the peoples and nations of those landmasses.<ref name="IS2" /> In the process, he expanded the Atrisian Empire to rule&mdash;either directly or indirectly&mdash;over the entire planet,<ref name="Files" /> and, with Tching's victory over the last of the continents, the use of Atrisian writing system was likewise established planetwide.<ref name="Written" /> The fifty-fourth emperor of Atrisia thus concluded<ref name="Files" /> the Kitel Phard Dynasty's efforts to unite their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] and usher in a golden age.<ref name="IS2" /> Subsequently, Atrisia was sometimes known as Kitel Phard after the dynasty.<ref name="TEA" />

===A successful tyrant===
{{Quote|The ancient emperor's success against the peoples and nations of the newly-discovered continents on his world was spectacular; of greater interest to Infiltration is the manner in which Uueg Tching managed to subvert no fewer than 30 separate rebellions against his tyrannical rule.|An Imperial Security Bureau report|<ref name="IS2" />}}
An enlightened despot,<ref name="Files" /> Tching employed ruthless but brilliant [[Politics/Legends|political]] gambits,<ref name="Written" /> and his rule was both tyrannical and successful, the latter of which he attributed to having insight in [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomacy]], grand strategy, and effective use of [[Spy/Legends|spies]].<ref name="Files" /> Nevertheless, at least thirty separate rebellions were planned against Tching's rule, although he managed to subvert all of them.<ref name="IS2" /> On one occasion, he gave a speech on the rooting out of corruption that was also written down,<ref name="Insider70" /> and he provided subtle political and strategic advice in writing, as well.<ref name="Written" />

[[File:Uueg_Tching_Sayings_SWAJ14.png|thumb|left|300px|The original manuscript of the ''Sayings'', authored by Uueg Tching, the fifty-fourth Atrisian Emperor.]]
At some point, Tching had his court scribes,<ref name="Written" /> who followed him everywhere,<ref name="Files" /> [[Limb/Legends|hand]]-record what would become known as the ''[[Sayings]]''.<ref name="Written" /> It was a collection of parables, analogies, and cold-blooded instructions<ref name="Files" /> and advice<ref name="Written" /> that was intended to serve as a guide to Tching's heirs. Covering political manipulation, grand strategy, internal rule, and conquest, the document marked a change in Atrisian politics from brutal warfare toward the use of infiltration, espionage, and [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]]. Tching later made hand-written additions, clarifications, and notes on the scrolls containing the ''Sayings'', and, at least three [[Millennium/Legends|thousand years]]<ref name="Files" /> prior to [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]],<ref name="11 ABY">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}} is set shortly after the re-establishment of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] following the [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|final defeat]] of the resurrected [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].</ref> the original manuscript of the document was stored in the [[Rare Books Department]] of the [[Atrisian Imperial Historical Library]], where it remained for millennia.<ref name="Files" />

===Successors===
{{Quote|''[The ''Sayings'']'' were intended to be a guide to ''[Uueg Tching's]'' descendants, but few of the following Atrisian Emperors of the Tching Dynasty bothered to learn from his sayings (among the few who did are the famous Invisible Empress, Oeana Tching, and Eoaq the Expansive).|Lecture by Doctor Corellia Antilles|<ref name="Files" />}}
Tching eventually became a legendary Atrisian Emperor<ref name="IS2" /> who was remembered by the Atrisians for being skillful at diplomacy, war, and the maintaining of order. He was succeeded by the [[Tching Dynasty]]; however, few of its emperors bothered to heed the advice contained in the ''Sayings''. Some exceptions who did do so where [[Oeana Tching]]&mdash;the famous "Invisible Empress"&mdash;and [[Eoaq the Expansive]].<ref name="Files" />°

The latter Atrisian Emperor brought about numerous [[Eoaq reforms|reforms]] to the Atrisian Empire's bureaucracy. Although the [[Six Savage Viziers]] enacted counter-reforms that rolled back most of those changes, one that endured was the emperor's simplification of the Atrisian script.<ref name="Written" /> Approximately [[1489 BBY|fifteen hundred years]] prior to<ref name="Files" /> 11 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="11 ABY" /> the ruling [[Atrisian Emperor (Sayings)|Atrisian Emperor]]&mdash;in order to display the superiority of Tching and, by extension, himself&mdash;had a small run of the ''Sayings'' printed for the Atrisian [[Noble/Legends|nobility]].<ref name="Files" />

===Impact on the Republic===
{{Quote|''[&hellip;]'' brigade leader Nenevanth Tion ''[&hellip;]'' recited a speech from the Kitel Phard Dynasty of the Atrisi system. Invoking the ancient words of the 54th Emperor, Uueg Tching, Tion quoted from a speech regarding the routing of corruption.|HoloNet News report|<ref name="Insider70" />}}
[[File:70RepublicYouthSpeechFinal.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Commission for the Protection of the Republic SAGroup brigade leader Nenevanth Tion (center) recited a speech by Atrisian Emperor Uueg Tching at a parade held on Coruscant.]]
The [[Atrisian Parliament]] eventually wrested power from the Atrisian [[Throne/Legends|throne]] and, to demonstrate that authority,<ref name="Files" /> around [[539 BBY]]<ref name="539 BBY">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}, which is set shortly after the re-establishment of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] following the [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|final defeat]] of the resurrected [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], establishes that the ''[[Sayings]]'' were made available to the general public 550 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the former events to [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], the latter must have occurred around [[539 BBY]].</ref> it made the ''Sayings'' publicly available both in a general database format and in a special printed edition.<ref name="Files" /> After Tching's work began to make its way offworld, employees of<ref name="Written" /> the intelligence-gathering agency known as<ref name="IS2" /> the [[Special Acquisitions Branch]] of the [[Library of the Republic]] came to appreciate the ancient emperor.<ref name="Written" />

On the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[21 BBY/Legends|14:9:04]], [[SAGroup (COMPOR)/Legends|SAGroup]] chapter members of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Commission for the Protection of the Republic/Legends|Commission for the Protection of the Republic]] held a parade on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Insider70" /> the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet.<ref name="TEA" /> During the ceremony, which was broadcast live throughout the Core Worlds, the fifteen-year&ndash;old SAGroup [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]] leader [[Nenevanth Tion]] recited a speech by Tching, a fact that was later noted by a news report of the [[HoloNet News Core Edition|Core Edition]] of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]].<ref name="Insider70" /> In rhetoric addressed at the [[Senator/Legends|senators]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Farlander">{{StoryCite|story=The Farlander Papers|book=Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)}}</ref> that was [[Declaration of a New Order|formed]] from the Republic in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]&ndash;turned&ndash;[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] promised to bring about a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] golden age akin to that achieved by the Kitel Phard Dynasty, a claim that was later noted by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] in a speech held on the planet [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]].<ref name="Farlander" />

===Later legacy===
{{Quote|Uueg, the 54th Atrisian Emperor, was famous for his successful tyrannical rule, which he attributed to his insight in diplomacy, grand strategy, and effective use of spies. ''[&hellip;]'' An enlightened despot, he is remembered by Atrisians for his skill in diplomacy, in war, and in maintaining order.|Lecture by Doctor Corellia Antilles|<ref name="Files" />}}
[[File:CorelliaAntilles-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Doctor Corellia Antilles gave a lecture mentioning the Atrisian Emperors at the Galactic Museum.]]
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Atrisians still remembered the rulers of the Kitel Phard Dynasty with pride.<ref name="IS2" /> The Special Acquisitions Branch's appreciation of the fifty-fourth Atrisian Emperor carried over to its successor, [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]],<ref name="Written" /> with the latter's [[Infiltration]] branch being particularly interested about Tching's dealings with the rebellions against his rule and with new Infiltration recruits being told legends about the ancient ruler.<ref name="IS2" />

The Atrisian Emperors, including Tching, were mentioned in a compilation of Imperial documents&mdash;including an [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] report sent to the [[ISB Central Office/Legends|ISB Central Office]]&mdash;made shortly after the Battle of Yavin by Rebel [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]] for Mothma and other Rebel [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="IS2" /> They were also covered in a lecture by the [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Henrietya Antilles|Corellia Antilles]] given at the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]]<ref name="Files" /> around 11 ABY.<ref name="11 ABY" /> During the lecture, Antilles speculated that the original manuscript of the ''Sayings'' disappeared into Palpatine's private holdings approximately [[1 BBY/Legends|twelve years]] earlier because the Galactic Emperor had mastered the methods espoused by Tching and wanted to possess the scrolls containing his work as a trophy.<ref name="Files" /> In [[38 ABY]], the [[Xenolinguist/Legends|xenolinguist]] Doctor [[Milanda Vorgan]]'s publication "[[The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic]]" also documented the contribution of the Atrisian Emperors to the development of the Atrisian script.<ref name="Written" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Impsourcebook.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The title of Emperor of Atrisia was introduced in the ''Imperial Sourcebook''.]]
The title "Emperor of Atrisia" was first mentioned in [[Greg Gorden]]'s [[1989]] ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> In [[August]] [[1997]], the article "[[From the Files of Corellia Antilles]]," which was authored by [[Timothy S. O'Brien|Timothy O'Brien]] and published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 14|fourteenth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine, identified the title as the Atrisian Emperor.<ref name="Files" />

The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' featured the first illustration of an Atrisian Emperor&mdash;Uueg Tching&mdash;which was done by [[Chris Trevas]];<ref name="TEA" /> furthermore, according to an outline for Fry and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]'s [[2012]] reference book, ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', that work would have featured a section focusing on Tching. However, the section was ultimately not included in the book.<ref name="AuthorCut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-12-tales-of-the-new-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 12: Tales of the New Republic}}</ref> During the writing of the [[2010]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article "[[The Written Word]],"<ref name="Endnotes">{{Blog|JSarek|8|Endnotes for The Written Word}}</ref> which mentioned the Atrisian Emperor Eoaq the Expansive's reforms to the bureaucracy of the Atrisian Empire and its script, the author [[John Hazlett]]<ref name="Written" /> was inspired by the reforms made by the real-world<ref name="Endnotes" /> [[Wikipedia:17th century|17th]]&ndash;[[Wikipedia:18th century|18th century]] [[Wikipedia:Tsar of all Russia|tsar]] and later [[Wikipedia:Emperor of Russia|Emperor of Russia]] [[Wikipedia:Peter the Great|Peter the Great]],<ref name="PeterBritannica">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/biography/Peter-the-Great|text=Peter I &#124; Biography, Accomplishments, Reforms, Facts, Significance, & Death|author=The Editors of Encyclopædia Britannica|date=2024-10-04|work=[[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|''Encyclopædia Britannica'']]|archivedate=20241221102945}}</ref> including [[Wikipedia:Reforms of Russian orthography|those]] made to the Russian [[Wikipedia:Cyrillic script|Cyrillic script]].<ref name="Endnotes" />
